title: Introducing Continuous Profiling in Odigos: Low Overhead, Zero Extra Storage
summary: Continuous profiling is now built into Odigos. Collect and visualize profiles directly in Odigos with a lightweight in-memory experience, and optionally export via OTLP Profiles for historical analysis in your favorite destinations.
body_markdown: Continuous profiling is now built into Odigos. Collect and visualize profiles directly in Odigos with a lightweight in-memory experience, and optionally export via OTLP Profiles for historical analysis in your favorite destinations.
